reviews.author: Taylor S.
reviews.text: Staff is without a doubt some of the most patient and caring individuals I have met. They deal with our son who is literally all gas no break with compassion. His progression from bouncing around and doing push-ups for correction constantly has progressed dramatically. The positive influence this has had on him is unmeasurable. Highly recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Sarah G.
reviews.text: My daughter is 5 and started a year ago in the little warrior classes and absolutely loves it. It has a great family atmosphere, the instructors are fantastic and she has learned so much about karate, self discipline and herself. It has also given her a positive focus for her energy, helped her make new friends and raised her self confidence. Its a great program and I can't say enough good thing.

reviews.author: Jacy D.
reviews.text: This is a fantastic place to take children so that they can gain great social skills, develop the ability to defend themselves, and learn about Jesus Christ and how great He truly is.
